source_name: Slovenska bankova asociacia — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Association posts event photos/announcements tagging attending bank executives with current titles; LinkedIn event pages for SK banking conferences also expose attendee/speaker identities. Strong cross-check for a title first seen on an agenda.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of Slovak associations (SAPIE, ITAS, AmCham, Klub 500, SAF, Britcham)
why_relevant: Associations announce new board members, executive hires and working-group launches on LinkedIn first; the pages also expose associated people. This is the fastest-moving leadership-move channel for this cell — but access is restricted and scraping is against ToS.

source_name: Webmagazin/Teraz.sk business section (TASR-fed corporate appointments)
why_relevant: Republishes SK corporate appointment announcements (e.g. KPMG SK new partners), providing a redundant capture path when the primary newsroom page is restructured or removed.

source_name: Amrop Slovensko legacy site – articles (amrop.sk)
why_relevant: Older Slovak-language article archive of Amrop SK with thought-leadership on management hiring practices; useful for historical baseline of search-firm commentary.

source_name: Bizdata.sk — dátové registre (SK company data provider)
why_relevant: Alternative commercial/technical provider documenting which Slovak state registers it ingests and how. Useful as a second normalised feed and as documentation of register update cadence and field structure; reduces dependence on a single aggregator.

source_name: Currency Research — Cash Cycle Seminar (ICCOS) EMEA/Europe
why_relevant: Premier global cash-management seminar series (EMEA edition Cape Town, 30 Nov - 2 Dec 2026). Central-bank cash departments and CIT operators speak; NBS/SK cash-cycle staff appearances would be direct evidence of who owns cash operations. No CEE-specific 2026 edition was found.

source_name: EuropaWire — EU press-release distribution (bank group releases)
why_relevant: Carries verbatim English copies of Erste Group releases about Slovak subsidiary appointments and CEE divisional leadership (e.g. the Slovenska sporitelna CEO succession and a 2026 Central-Europe corporate-division head appointment), giving a searchable secondary index.

source_name: European e-Justice Portal — Business registers, Slovakia (BRIS entry point)
why_relevant: English-language gateway to the SK register through the EU Business Registers Interconnection System. Useful for cross-border cases — a Slovak branch (organizačná zložka) of an Austrian/Czech bank, or a SK subsidiary of an EU payments group — because BRIS links the SK entry to the parent's home register and, per the portal, allows free application for extracts and deposited documents.

source_name: Gi Group Slovakia (parent of Grafton SK) – insights
why_relevant: Parent group republishes and extends Grafton's SK labour-market analysis; sometimes carries commentary not on grafton.sk.

source_name: Jooble Slovakia — aggregated bank vacancies
why_relevant: Cross-board aggregator; useful as a breadth net and for detecting postings on boards not directly monitored. Counts are inflated/duplicated, so use for discovery, not measurement.

source_name: KiTalent — Bratislava executive search with continuous talent mapping
why_relevant: Claims continuous talent mapping across Bratislava financial services — i.e. it maintains exactly the person-level org map this cell wants, and publishes fragments of it as marketing content.

source_name: MarketScreener — issuer profiles and board rosters (Tatra banka, KBC, Erste)
why_relevant: Aggregator carrying board-member rosters for Tatra banka (SK1110001502 is listed on BSSE) plus mirrored group presentations. Useful as a cheap diffable roster and as a fallback when a parent PDF is paywalled or moved.

source_name: OTP Group — investor news archive
why_relevant: OTP exited Slovakia (sale of OTP Banka Slovensko to KBC, agreed Feb 2020, closed 27 Nov 2020), so this is now a historical/baseline source rather than a live channel. Keep on low-frequency watch in case of re-entry or CEE reshuffles touching Slovakia.

source_name: Parlamentne listy SK — labour/union arena coverage
why_relevant: Carries union-side and politically framed accounts of bank employment conditions and strike threats that mainstream outlets under-report; useful for early detection of labour conflict, but strongly opinionated and needs corroboration.

source_name: Podnikam.sk / Podnikajte.sk — praktické výklady k ORSR, RÚZ a RPVS
why_relevant: Business-press explainers on register procedure, RÚZ filing obligations and RPVS duties, kept current year to year. Useful glossary and procedural reference for a non-native analyst, and a cheap way to notice when the rules or portals change.

source_name: PozriPracu.sk — employer vacancy pages
why_relevant: Secondary aggregator with per-employer pages; useful as a redundancy check when a primary board or ATS is blocked or restructured.

source_name: Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) — Erste Group dual listing page AT0000652011
why_relevant: Erste Group is dual-listed in Prague; the exchange page aggregates issuer announcements in English and gives a second, independent publication venue for regulated news relevant to the CEE/Slovak segment.

entity_name: RocketReach company profiles for SK banking entities
source_name: RocketReach company profiles for SK banking entities (headcount proxy)
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that mirrors LinkedIn-derived employee counts and executive names, usable as a headcount-trend proxy where LinkedIn itself cannot be automated. Accuracy is uneven, so treat as a corroborating signal only.

source_name: SBA Educa — examinations body for financial intermediaries
why_relevant: SBA's training/exam arm; its governance and lecturer/examiner lists name banking professionals, and exam volumes are a proxy for hiring flows into financial intermediation.

source_name: Slovak aggregator/rewrite tier (24hod.sk, Topky.sk, Androidportal.sk, Kryptomagazin.sk, Emefka.sk, Regiony/bratislava.zoznam.sk)
why_relevant: A broad rewrite layer that surfaces bank layoff and branch-closure narratives with aggressive headlines ('Banky na Slovensku v KRIZE: MASIVNE zatvaranie pobociek a prepustanie'). Low authority, but excellent for cheap recall: they mirror wire items that sit behind paywalls elsewhere, and their pickup volume is itself a signal of how salient a restructuring story is.

source_name: Swiss Re Bratislava careers (financial-services shared-service hub)
why_relevant: Non-bank financial hub in Bratislava posting payments/cash-and-bank roles; a useful benchmark for the SK financial back-office labour market and competing employers for payments talent.

source_name: Talentuch – recruitment blog
why_relevant: IT/RPO recruiter with Slovak roots; blog covers IT talent supply (SAP, MS Dynamics) relevant to bank/payments technology hiring, though not banking-specific.

source_name: Technická univerzita v Košiciach (TUKE) – Ekonomická fakulta (Finance, Banking and Investment)
why_relevant: Regional talent pipeline for banking back-office and risk roles; faculty news, career-day and partnership announcements reveal which banks/centres are recruiting graduates in eastern Slovakia. TUKE is also a Košice IT Valley member, linking academia to captive employers.
